title: Formula 2030: A first look at the next generation of Polestars
summary: Formula 2030 is more than a show car. It is Polestar's next chapter in physical form. Head of Design Philipp Römers explains what to expect from future Polestars, why the next generation puts the driver first, and how Polestar could become the car culture brand 2.0.
body_markdown:
Show cars sometimes get a bad rep. Over-the-top creations that rarely make it beyond the stand. Formula 2030 isn't that. Its design is already heading for the road, starting with the new Polestar 2 and the upcoming Polestar 7.


"Formula 2030 is more than a design exercise," says Philipp Römers, Head of Design at Polestar. "It's the physical embodiment of our overall strategy. It's the essence of our brand, our design language, our technology roadmap and our portfolio of the future."


That strategy points somewhere specific. Polestar is becoming a more accessible premium performance brand, moving into more compact segments. So the concept takes a compact form. "It made sense to me to show the design as a compact, practical sports car," says Römers. "This is the essence of our future portfolio."


## Four cars in one


Formula 2030 is one car. But look closely and you'll see four. The front previews the reimagined Polestar 2, due in 2027. The rear previews the upcoming Polestar 7. In between, it draws on two cars already on the road.


The side profile carries the performance DNA of Polestar 5. "A strong muscle above the rear wheel and an overall low profile," says Römers. "The proportions scream performance."


Over that sits the crossover silhouette of Polestar 4. On a sports car, the combination is unexpected. That is the point. "Polestar is all about character," he says.


## A new face


The front end shows Polestar's new face for the first time. The Dual Blade headlights stay. This time, they are joined by the front aero wing first seen on Polestar Precept and Polestar 3.


"This face has tons of character, tons of presence," says Römers. "And at the same time, it speaks Polestar." It will reach the road first on the new Polestar 2.


At the rear, a new light graphic answers the front. Called the Single Blade, it is the clearest indication yet of how Polestar 7 will look, in both volume and lighting. "It fits perfectly with the Dual Blade on the front," he says.
